title: Information collection 1959 - 291645977
doc_notes: This document consists of two reports from the U.S. Naval Air Station at Point Mugu regarding sightings of unidentified flying objects by local police officers in June 1959.

incidents.summary: Police Officer Orville Clinton observed four round, silvery objects moving northward near San Cayetano Mountain.
behavior: two objects moved together and apart
incidents.explanation: Possible cause of the sighting is undetermined.
incidents.quote: Objects disappeared by just fading away from sight.
incidents.size: two times the size of a basketball

incidents.summary: Police Sergeant D. A. Kelly and Officer Paul Lydick observed four round, white objects moving slowly toward the northwest over the foothills.
incidents.explanation: Possible cause of the sighting is undetermined.
incidents.quote: Objects appeared to be moving in a line slowly toward the northwest.
incidents.size: twice as big as a basketball
